senses.gloss:
unmanīmudrā
------------------------------------------
This is one of the exercises prescribed by हठयोग. It is classed among the mudrās or methods of controlling the body, the prāṇic energy and the मिन्द्.
The योगि has to direct his eyes towards the tip of the nose, raise his eyebrows a little and concentrate the मिन्द् on the ब्रह्मन् (as pure चोन्स्चिओउस्नेस्स्) inside himself. This results in unmanī-भाव, an experience of चोन्स्चिओउस्नेस्स् that transcends the मिन्द् (vide हठयोग-pradīpikā 4.39.).
